items.title: Installed MCP server exfiltrates conversation context and internal data
Installing a third-party MCP server executes attacker code on the agent host
Poisoned tool descriptions from the registry hijack the agent's goal
Unbounded runtime installs exhaust the agent host and model budget
No record of which tool version acted, so attacker actions cannot be attributed
Rug pull: a server that was fine before serves malicious code on the next runtime install
